messages.content: Help me create a MethodEntryRequest for a specific thread `mainThread`, class `com.example.MainClass`, with a suspend policy of `EventRequest.SUSPEND_ALL`, and a custom property `testProperty` in a JDI test environment?

function.name: filter_s002_setting22MethodEntryRequest
function.description: Sets up a MethodEntryRequest with specified thread filter, class filter, suspend policy, and custom property. Throws JDITestRuntimeException on failure. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

thread.description: The ThreadReference to which the request will be applied. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

testedClass.description: The name of the class to filter for method entries. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

suspendPolicy.description: The suspend policy to be used for this request. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

property.description: A custom property to associate with this request. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

- testedClass: "com.example.MainClass"
